chapter: Rhythm Club memories and playing technique
title: Musicians sitting in at the Onyx with Stuff Smith

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did he used to bring a lot of people off the stands?

Well no, mostly everybody knew that about Stuff and used to come up there and sit in you know and play. Artie Dollinger was a saxophone player, later on he was on staff. He used to come in and sit and play with us all the time. Bernie Privin, come in and sit in with us. Jack Teagarden, Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy, Artie Shaw, Benny, Chris Griffin, Ziggie Elman, Allen Reuss, guitar. What's the trombone player's name, oh, he used to be with Benny. He used to come in all the time and sit in.
Lou McGarity. Lou McGarity, great trombonist Lou McGarity and what's the one that had the band? Williams.
No, this is a white guy. Had a band. Trombone, not Sandy Williams. This is going way back now, this is going way back.
Trombone. I'll think of that name later, too.
Well anyway, there's a lot of them, a tremendous number of people that you, you know had contact with. One way or the other in those days.
